details.fee_pricing_html: CREATED. Self-contained bulk pricing page. Two-tier selection: GET filter form (class_id/term_id selects preserving selection via selected_class_id == c.id|stringformat:'s' pattern) submitting to school_admin:fee_pricing. When no class+term selected: hint card 'Select a class and term to set pricing' with sliders-horizontal icon. When selected: summary line '<class> — <term>', POST form to school_admin:fee_pricing with hidden class_id/term_id, one-row-per-category table (violet tags icon + number input). Empty-categories state shows card linking to fee_category_create. Save Pricing + Cancel (fee_structure_list) buttons.
details.prefill_pattern: Amount prefill uses the for-loop-inside-value pattern: value="{% for key, val in existing.items %}{% if key == category.pk %}{{ val }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}". Verified by rendering with mocked context: existing={1:'50000.00', 3:'7500.50'} produced amount_1=50000.00, amount_2='' (no entry), amount_3=7500.50. No custom filter needed. Backend view (fees.py FeePricingView) confirmed to pass existing as dict keyed by category_id and reads amount_<pk> on POST.
